info.description: Rotatable 3D preview for a piece of gear (e.g. photogrammetry-scanned speaker.glb) OR a plain reference image, matching TOPICS[].model in studio-vr's courseData.js. studio-vr picks which one to render off the uploaded file's mime type (see studio-backend's course.mapper.ts deriveAssetType).

kind.description: Procedural-placeholder fallback identifier used by studio-vr's GearModelViewer when no scan/image file is present (e.g. "speaker").

file.description: Either a .glb/.gltf scan OR any image (png/jpg/webp/etc.) to show in its place, uploaded via the S3 provider. studio-vr renders whichever one is present.
